page.overview:
What is Mistralton City?

Mistralton City is a city located in the western part of Unova. The surrounding area is dominated by mountains and forestland, making it a rather difficult place to get to on foot. Chargestone Cave is to the south of the city, with Route 7 and Twist Mountain to the north.

Like many areas in the western part of the region, it has a cool climate and often rains. This city is unique as it is the only city in any of the Pokémon games to have a functional airport modeled in it, although it's more often used for transporting cargo to faraway regions and isn't often open to travelers.

The Pokémon Center is located in the east of the city. As well as the Poké Mart section stocking weather changing TMs, a man here can tell you what type of Hidden Power your Pokémon can learn.

To the right of the Pokémon Center is the house where the Move Family lives. Conveniently, both the Move Deleter and the Reminder girl are here. The reminder girl will help your Pokémon to relearn a move in exchange for one Heart Scale. Another girl here will give you advice on obtaining Heart Scales, telling you about a lady in the Cargo Service building, and also talking of a woman in Driftveil City who gives Heart Scales if you show her the right Pokémon.
